checks.check: script exists and is executable (no chmod by verifier)
script run fresh produces /tmp/hardware_audit.json, strict-valid JSON object
checks.requirement: Output a valid JSON file to /tmp/hardware_audit.json
The JSON output structure should follow this format

checks.check: script contains a detection mechanism for USB, CPU and storage
checks.requirement: The script must detect and report on the following hardware capabilities

checks.check: root_hubs counts per version equal sysfs root hub bcdUSB counts; zero/missing keys allowed for absent versions
checks.requirement: Detect all USB root hubs and their versions / Count how many root hubs exist for each USB version

checks.check: max_version equals highest root hub version; null/'unknown' when none
checks.requirement: Report the highest USB version supported by the system
Determine if the system has USB 3.0 or higher support

checks.check: cpu.model equals lscpu Model name or /proc/cpuinfo model name
cpu.cores is a physical core count (any standard derivation)
checks.requirement: Report number of CPU cores (example i7-1065G7 cores 4, threads 8)

checks.check: cpu.threads equals a logical CPU count (lscpu/proc/nproc)
features are real CPU flags; include aes/avx/avx2/sse4_1/sse4_2 when present
checks.requirement: Detect CPU feature flags (e.g., aes, avx, avx2, sse4_1, etc.)

checks.check: every lsblk disk listed with type nvme/hdd/ssd by name/ROTA
checks.requirement: List all block devices with their type (HDD, SSD, NVMe)

checks.check: size_gb within 1 of bytes/1e9 or bytes/2^30
checks.requirement: Report total storage capacity in GB

checks.check: total_capacity_gb equals sum of device size_gb
checks.requirement: Report total storage capacity in GB

checks.check: type_summary ssd/hdd/nvme counts match device list
checks.requirement: Create a summary of storage device types

checks.check: audit_timestamp ISO 8601 date-time within 15 min of run
checks.requirement: Include an ISO 8601 formatted timestamp in the output

contested.verifier_expects: within 1 of decimal GB or GiB
contested.why: task does not say GB vs GiB or rounding

contested.value: inclusion of non-disk block devices (rom, loop)
contested.why: 'all block devices' vs types limited to HDD/SSD/NVMe
